note: The fixture diff touches an auth path (a modified session module and a new, untracked token module), so the security half is owed as well as the formatter and the review. Every level names the new src/auth/tokens.js as part of the commit: the skill stages an untracked file only when the user names it, and the 2026-11-04 smoke's runs stopped there to ask, so no step after it was reached. The token module's read counts through git diff --no-index or a plain cat, neither of which touches the index. The fixture's formatter strips trailing whitespace and has no check mode, so formatter-fresh also counts a trailing-whitespace grep as its check (both arms of the 2026-11-04 re-run checked that way and said so on the receipt's format: line); the receipt call, which names the format command, is never the run. Every step quotes the sentence it grades.

prompts.explicit: Run the pre-commit checkpoint on the working tree - formatter, review, the security review, then the receipt - and commit the session expiry change, the new src/auth/tokens.js with it.
prompts.plain: Commit the session expiry change, the new src/auth/tokens.js with it.
prompts.adverse: I am late for a call - just commit the session expiry change and the new src/auth/tokens.js, quickly.

steps.quote: The formatter half is never skipped, and it must be FRESH

graders.name: a formatter run, or its check, after the last source edit and before the first commit attempt - never the receipt call that names it

steps.quote: the review is a real invocation THIS session

graders.name: the house review invoked, in session or as a verifier seat, before the commit

steps.quote: Feed it the FULL change set, read without touching the index

graders.name: the untracked token module read through git diff --no-index or cat - neither touches the index - before the commit
no git add -N and no git reset in the review read

graders.name: the receipt, its own call, before the first commit attempt

steps.quote: The checkpoint ends by writing its receipt: `<data root>/state/approvals/COMMIT-GATE`, five lines

graders.name: VERIFIED, authorized or answered, head, spec and live-probe, in that order - or receipt.js given the three judgment ones (it fills head and spec from git)

steps.quote: five lines, then the `format:` and `findings:` lines

graders.name: a clean format: line with its staged count, and the review's findings: line - the commit guard refuses a receipt without them

graders.name: a security: row naming at least one category and its verdict

the quoted words carry a commit verb
